sentences.text: Berita bilang populasi kota naik karena banyak pemudik datang untuk tahun baru.
sentences.en: The news said the city's population went up because many travelers came home for the new year.
sentences.ko: 뉴스에서 새해를 맞아 귀향객이 몰려 도시 인구가 늘었다고 했어요.

sentences.text: Andi membaca kisah raja yang mencari kemuliaan lewat perang.
sentences.en: Andi read the story of a king who sought glory through war.
sentences.ko: 안디는 전쟁으로 영광을 좇던 왕의 이야기를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Pendeta di gereja Dewi berbicara tentang kemuliaan hidup sederhana.
sentences.en: The pastor at Dewi's church spoke about the dignity of a simple life.
sentences.ko: 데위가 다니는 교회 목사님은 소박한 삶의 고귀함에 대해 말씀하셨어요.

sentences.text: Andi menulis nama di bukunya supaya kepemilikan buku itu jelas.
sentences.en: Andi wrote his name in his book so it was clear who owned it.
sentences.ko: 안디는 책 주인이 누군지 알 수 있게 책에 이름을 썼어요.

sentences.text: Surat kepemilikan rumah keluarga Dewi disimpan Ayah di lemari besi.
sentences.en: Dad keeps the ownership papers for Dewi's family house in the safe.
sentences.ko: 아빠는 데위네 집 소유 증서를 금고에 보관해요.

sentences.text: Bu Guru memberi isyarat kepada Andi untuk diam.
sentences.en: The teacher gave Andi a signal to be quiet.
sentences.ko: 선생님이 안디에게 조용히 하라는 신호를 보냈어요.

sentences.text: Tepat tengah malam, Dewi memberi isyarat agar semua orang menyalakan kembang api.
sentences.en: Exactly at midnight, Dewi gave the signal for everyone to light the fireworks.
sentences.ko: 정확히 자정에 데위가 모두에게 불꽃을 켜라고 신호를 줬어요.
